payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about state-of-the-art baseline models used for SQL generation, including their adaptations and performance characteristics.

claims.text: The two baseline models are Context-dependent Seq2Seq (CD-Seq2Seq) and SyntaxSQL-con, both adapted for SQL generation tasks.
CD-Seq2Seq incorporates a bi-LSTM database schema encoder to improve context-dependent SQL generation.
SyntaxSQL-con uses bi-LSTMs and a column attention mechanism to enhance performance in SQL query response tasks.
Performance of the baselines decreases as the turn number increases in interaction tasks.
